items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Now, Chéng, move the bowl of medicine on the table into my hand using only your family's technique.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Why?

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Do you often make a habit of arguing with your elders?

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Brewing and serving medicine is part of the clinic's duties. But, if you'd prefer to lie around and take advantage of my hospitality for the next few days, be my guest.
Chéng falls silent for a moment, then extends his right hand and aims it at the bowl of medicine.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Urgh. Hngh!
In an instant, the medicine bowl turns black and spins forward, almost crashing into Doctor Xiù's hand.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Hmm. A little excessive, but all in all, not bad for a first try.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Although, it is rather heavy. I wonder why.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Hahahaha!
She breaks into a cheerful laugh, then props the metal bowl upright and shows it to Chéng.
The medicinal broth inside the bowl has been transmuted along with it, becoming a solid block of metal.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Fortunately, the effect wears off in time; otherwise, you'd be paying for the medicine.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Have patience. Remember, a single day does not make a master.

items.speaker: Old Man
items.text: Owww!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: It's been a long while since I've used it so much.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: With a little more practice, I know I will perform it without error.
Doctor Xiù retrieves several chipped, broken bowls from around the room.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Well, you're not lacking for confidence. Why not begin with these? Once you've mastered them, lighter things like flowers and leaves should be no problem at all.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Your arcane skill works much like my own, simple, really. Sense the flow of Qi, carefully straighten it, and aim it at the object.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: And strike.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Hyah!
The metal bowl slams into the wall once again, and Chéng's brow knots even tighter.

items.speaker: Hunter
items.text: Young man, I have watched you throw that broken bowl around day after day, and I still can't fathom why Doctor Xiù is making you do it.
Having woken up with little else to occupy him, the tiger-bitten hunter has decided to strike up a conversation with Chéng.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I'm training my arcane skill.
Unable to resist, the remaining two bedridden patients chime in as well.

items.speaker: Old Man
items.text: Training? That old lady can't even throw a punch. What, does she think she's some sort of martial arts master now?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: What do you mean "can't throw a punch"?

items.speaker: Young Man
items.text: Haha! Did she catch you off guard too?

items.speaker: Young Man
items.text: She looks fierce, has a bad temper, and talks loud enough to rattle the bedpans, but I've never once seen Doctor Xiù get into a fight with anyone.

items.speaker: Old Man
items.text: Her arcane skill, those silver threads of hers, is finer than hair. Other than stitching up wounds, what good could they be?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: The thought hadn't occurred to me.

items.speaker: Hunter
items.text: Come now, you can hardly say that! At the Dushuo Festival, Doctor Xiù played a female soldier, remember? "Kill! Kill!" She was like a demoness, fierce as anything!

items.speaker: Young Man
items.text: Come on, anyone can shout! I could just as well play a great general! "All troops, heed my command!"
Another metal bowl rolls onto the floor.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Still, I hear there was once a bandit in Huanzhou who fought with silver threads.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: They say the bandit stole state supplies, torched villages, and left many soldiers wounded.

items.speaker: Old Man
items.text: I've heard traveling merchants talk about the very same thing. They say those silver threads could cut through iron like mud. Frightening stuff.

items.speaker: Old Man
items.text: In the end, the bandit raided Zhu County. But, after that, word of them vanished.

items.speaker: Young Man
items.text: Zhu County?! That's the richest place in all of Huanzhou! All manner of merchants and officials live there.

items.speaker: Young Man
items.text: Not like this poor backwater town we're stuck in.

items.speaker: Hunter
items.text: Nonsense! Doctor Xiù would never stoop to being some lowly mountain bandit! If she could fight, she'd be a hero!

items.speaker: Young Man
items.text: Plenty of people have similar arcane skills, don't they? I can produce flames from my fingertips, just like the Hú family!

items.speaker: Old Man
items.text: I suppose you're right. I've never seen her use those silver threads for anything practical, not even to slice a vegetable. Perhaps they simply aren't good for much!

items.speaker: Hunter
items.text: You could walk every street of the village saying she's a bandit, and I bet not a soul would believe it.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Is that so?

items.speaker: Old Man
items.text: There was a time we didn't have a doctor in the village. Small illnesses, we just had to endure, and we couldn't afford the county fees for anything serious.

items.speaker: Old Man
items.text: After Doctor Xiù arrived, the villagers could finally get the treatment they needed.

items.speaker: Young Man
items.text: That's right. My son was having convulsions last year. It's thanks to her that he's still with us.
The metal bowl slowly rises, wobbling as it drifts toward the other side of the room.
Finally, it settles smoothly on the table.

items.speaker: Hunter
items.text: Well done, young man! It's about time you finally managed it!

items.speaker: Old Man
items.text: Now maybe you can get my medicine over here without spilling it!

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Ah, the Hú family's calling me over for medicine again! Ever sending their orders, yet never bothering to actually come to the clinic!

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: I swear, the day I end up saving their lives is the day I squeeze ten thousand taels out of them!

items.speaker: Assistant
items.text: Go ahead, Doctor. I'll keep an eye on the clinic.
Doctor Xiù is halfway across the threshold when a teacup suddenly spins in from behind, aimed at her side.

items.speaker: Assistant
items.text: Doctor!
Doctor Xiù doesn't even flinch. She reaches out her hand, and the teacup halts in midair before slowly dropping into her palm.
The cup's base gleams with a clean metallic sheen. The tea inside is perfectly brewed, the leaves fully unfurled and settled at the bottom.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: So?

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: To have come this far in just three days! Your progress is indeed worthy of praise.
Doctor Xiù drains the tea in one gulp, then steps out the door.
Side Room, Clinic
In the early hours of the morning, while the patients are still sleeping, Chéng Héguāng gathers the broken bowls together.
The doctor's assistant walks over carrying a bowl of medicinal broth.

items.speaker: Assistant
items.text: Time for your medicine, young man.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Hm? I don't recall Doctor Xiù prescribing me any additional medication.

items.speaker: Assistant
items.text: It's a new prescription, designed to help replenish your Qi.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Smells like Huangqi and Danggui. But my injury is already healed. There's no use wasting good medicine.

items.speaker: Assistant
items.text: You still need to make up for your Qi and blood loss. The doctor specially prescribed it for you.
Chéng frowns slightly but still takes the medicine and raises it to his lips.
A silver thread shoots in and knocks the medicine bowl from his hand.
It shatters with a sharp crack. Brown medicinal liquid splashes across the floor.
Doctor Xiù stands nearby with a hardened expression.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: That is not what I prescribed.

items.speaker: Assistant
items.text: Doctor! You've returned already?!

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: I came back for something. What's going on here?

items.speaker: Assistant
items.text: This new patient of yours, he's up to something.
The assistant pulls a pale yellow sheet of paper from his jacket and hands it to Doctor Xiù.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Did you go through my bag?!

items.speaker: Assistant
items.text: Regular visitors don't inquire about bandits at a clinic. You covered your tracks well, but not well enough!

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Let's see here. "The bandit known as 'Shuttlebones,' bearing arms in public, robbed the prefectural granary ..."

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: "The offender is a violent bandit who wields a bone shuttle and silver thread with deadly precision. All jurisdictions are commanded to conduct the arrest with extreme vigilance."

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: So this is the warrant for my arrest? My, my, look how hideous this drawing of me is. Who would even recognize me from such a scrawl? I suppose it was my arcane skill that gave me away, wasn't it?

items.speaker: Assistant
items.text: I'm sorry, Doctor. I wanted to deal with this before you returned.
Doctor Xiù folds the arrest warrant in half and tosses it into the nearby brazier.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Our curious patient here is Brother Chéng's child.

items.speaker: Assistant
items.text: Heh, I had my suspicions with that arcane skill of his.

items.speaker: Assistant
items.text: But so what if he is?! We helped Chéng Dàoguān when he needed it most. His son ought to help us in return! Besides, you've done nothing wrong!

items.speaker: Assistant
items.text: My daughter was starving to death while he dragged his feet every step of the way, acting the young lord. If it weren't you—
Doctor Xiù slams her palm down on the table beside her.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Enough! There's medicine that needs boiling.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Go!
The assistant casts an unwilling glance at Chéng, then leaves in sullen silence.
Doctor Xiù suddenly sweeps the metallized broken bowls to the floor.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: You said you're not with the Yamen.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I am not. But on occasion, I take bounty orders from them.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Ah, your "odd jobs." Is it the money you care for? Or is it something else?

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Why not confront me directly? Waiting for me to nurse you to health first? Planning to slit my throat in the night?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I've watched you for days. Nothing about you resembles a criminal.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: That warrant means nothing to me.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: If you swear to me that you never committed arson, hurt anyone, or raided Zhu County, then I will leave at once.
Doctor Xiù draws in a slow breath, her face returning to its usual calm.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: But I did it all.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Your injury's healed, hasn't it?

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Let's get started.
